spans.s:
(ऋ) वेहृ r. 1st cl. (वेहते)
To resolve or endeavour diligently; also sometimes read वेहृ.

f. (-हत्)
A cow miscarrying from taking the bull unseasonably.
E.
वि before हन् to kill (the embryo), Uṇādi aff. अति; the radical final rejected, and vowel changed.

r. 1st cl. (वेह्लति)
1 To go.
2 To tremble; also वेल and वेल्ल.
